method: standalone Assessment A in a fresh isolated Edge/Playwright context

heuristics.name: Visibility of System Status
heuristics.evidence: Search counts, copy feedback, and empty state use explicit feedback; live statuses are present.

heuristics.name: Match Between System and Real World
heuristics.evidence: Chinese icon meanings and search terms are clear; P0/P1 and code key naming assume maintainer context.

heuristics.name: User Control and Freedom
heuristics.evidence: Search can be cleared with focus restored and categories can be collapsed.

heuristics.name: Consistency and Standards
heuristics.evidence: Native buttons and details/summary patterns are consistent and keyboard operable.

heuristics.name: Error Prevention
heuristics.evidence: Examples and labels reduce search mistakes; the task has no destructive action.

heuristics.name: Recognition Rather Than Recall
heuristics.evidence: Cards show Chinese meaning and English key; Chinese synonyms can be searched.

heuristics.name: Flexibility and Efficiency of Use
heuristics.evidence: Search, keyboard clear, and Enter copy work; no shortcuts or favorites were found.

heuristics.name: Aesthetic and Minimalist Design
heuristics.evidence: Catalog and reference sections are distinct; compatibility table is cramped at 320px.

heuristics.name: Error Recovery
heuristics.evidence: Copy failure explains recovery and focuses/selects the full code.

heuristics.name: Help and Documentation
heuristics.evidence: Usage, motion, checklist, and alias guidance are on-page but require scrolling.

designSpecificity: Medium-strong; LinkX icon inventory and Chinese semantic search give the page a specific purpose, within a standard VitePress documentation frame.

failedItems: Chunking: the default-open P0 group contains 13 items.
Minimal choices: seven category groups and 13 desktop-visible P0 tiles exceed the four-choice reference threshold.

strengths: P0 group exposes 13 labeled icons, with four visible at 375px and two at 320px.
Persistent polite live regions announce empty-search and copy states; visual empty copy is aria-hidden.
Clipboard failure selects the full fallback code; keyboard clear and Enter copy work.

priorityIssues.title: Compatibility alias table is difficult to read at 320px
priorityIssues.evidence: alias table clientWidth=272, scrollWidth=302; explanation and source columns wrap vertically and extend past viewport edge
